name: Disneyland Docking Bay 7 "Fried Chicken Tip-Yip" with Macaroni & Cheese or Mashed Potato
brandOrRestaurant: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: A solid white-meat chicken cutlet served over creamy macaroni & cheese (or mashed potatoes with herb gravy on the side) with cooked broccoli—peeling off part of the crispy breading makes it a reliable Galaxy's Edge meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Fried Chicken Tip-Yip (adult or kids' portion with macaroni & cheese and steamed rice/potatoes), ask for gravy on the side, and peel off excess breading if sensitive to fryer oil.
watchOuts: Contains dairy in the mac & cheese—take lactase; skip the spicy Tuna Poke and Felucian chickpea hummus kefta during flares
